presentation.label: About Us
presentation.title: Ouémé Departmental Health Directorate
presentation.lead: The DDS-O is a decentralized structure of the Benin Ministry of Health, responsible for implementing the State's health policy in the Ouémé department.
presentation.description: Created in 2017 following the separation of Ouémé and Plateau departments, we coordinate public and private health services, supervise three health zones (ABD, AMAA, PNAS) and provide technical support to municipalities.

historique.title: Our History
historique.subtitle: A journey serving public health in Ouémé

intro.title: Decades serving health
intro.description: Since its creation, the Ouémé Departmental Health Directorate has undergone remarkable evolution, marked by structural reforms, innovations, and constant commitment to improving population health.

event1.title: Independence and Structuring
event1.description: After Benin's independence, establishment of first departmental health structures. Organization of the health system into regions and departments.

event2.title: Health System Reform
event2.description: Adoption of a national health policy focused on primary healthcare. Strengthening of departmental structures and creation of new health centers.

event3.title: Bamako Initiative
event3.description: Implementation of the Bamako Initiative to improve financial accessibility to care. Introduction of cost recovery system and community management.

event4.title: Creation of Health Zones
event4.description: Health division of the department into health zones for better territorial coverage and proximity management of health services.

event5.title: Maternal Health Program
event5.description: Launch of a vast program to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality with support from international partners. Massive training of midwives.

event6.title: Ouémé-Plateau Separation
event6.description: Official creation of the Ouémé Departmental Health Directorate following the administrative separation of Ouémé and Plateau departments. New structuring and strengthening of autonomy.

event7.title: COVID-19 Response
event7.description: Coordination of departmental response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Establishment of testing, treatment, and vaccination centers. Strengthening of epidemiological surveillance.

event8.title: System Digitalization
event8.description: Deployment of the e-SIGL system for electronic drug management and strengthening of the health information system. Introduction of digital solutions in health data management.

event9.title: Infrastructure Modernization
event9.description: Vast program of rehabilitation and equipping of health centers. Reception of hundreds of modern medical equipment including 600 cardiotocographs to improve pregnancy monitoring.

event10.title: Vision 2030
event10.description: Adoption of an ambitious strategic plan aiming for universal health coverage and excellence in health service delivery. Zero preventable maternal deaths by 2030.

future.title: Building the future together
future.description: With our rich history, we continue our mission with determination to build a stronger, more accessible, and more performant health system.
